title: XXH64 of byte buffers
summary: Hash a buffer of bytes, from empty to 1 MiB, with xxHash's 64-bit algorithm XXH64 (seed 0) to an unsigned 64-bit integer.
notes: Inputs are hex strings, because fixtures are shared as JSON; every adapter turns them into bytes in prepare, before any timing, so the measured call hashes bytes only. Results stay native unsigned 64-bit integers in the measured call; Python, Go and Rust write them as decimal strings for the verifier outside timing.
